Plot best linear projection coefficients

Source: R/margot_blp.R
margot_plot_blp.Rd

Draws a forest-style plot of [margot_blp()] coefficients with 95 intervals and a zero reference line, one facet per outcome. Nothing is coloured or annotated by significance, by design.

Usage

margot_plot_blp(
  blp,
  outcomes = NULL,
  terms = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  caption = .margot_blp_relativity_note()
)

Arguments

blp

A `margot_blp` data frame returned by [margot_blp()].

outcomes

Optional character vector of outcomes to retain, in the order given. Defaults to `NULL`, meaning every outcome.

terms

Optional character vector of coefficient terms to retain, in the order given. Defaults to `NULL`, meaning every term.

title

Optional plot title. Defaults to `NULL`.

caption

Plot caption. Defaults to the mandatory relativity sentence.

Value

A `ggplot` object.

See also

[margot_blp()], [margot_table_blp()]

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
blp <- margot_blp(cf)
margot_plot_blp(blp)
} # }
